Priya (New Hire): Quick question: I start Dec 15 — how many PTO hours do I have for the Dec 20-27 holiday blackout? Can I use carryover from previous employer?

PeopleOps Bot: Welcome Priya! Reminder: blackout window Dec 20-27 requires manager + People Ops sign-off for time off. New hires have prorated accrual; external carryover is not automatically transferable.

Priya (New Hire): Got it. Just want to check because family is arriving for a religious observance on the 24th and 25th. If accrual is low can we mark unpaid?

Samira (People Ops): Congrats and welcome! New hire accrual is pro-rated based on start date. For Dec 15 start, rough calc: 

```
Accrual estimate = (days employed in year / 365) * annual PTO
= (17 / 365) * 120 hours ≈ 5.6 hours
```

Samira (People Ops): That means you won't have full coverage for 24/25. We cannot accept carryover from another employer into Redwood payroll. Options: 1) manager swap/coverage, 2) use unpaid exception, 3) request to move the days (but blackout makes this harder).

Evan (Manager): I can try swapping shifts and cover some oncall overlap. Priya, can you share which exact hours you'll need?

Priya (New Hire): Mostly the 24th afternoon through 25th evening. I put tentative dates in the TimeOff app but didn't submit since I wasn't sure.

Samira (People Ops): Please submit formally and pick "Blackout Exception" if you want coverage approved during Dec20-27. Attach manager approval note. People Ops will review within 48 hours. If accrual is insufficient and you choose unpaid, mark it as "Unpaid Exception" so payroll tags it correctly.

Dana (Payroll): Heads-up: if unpaid, payroll needs the TimeOff ID and the unpaid flag to avoid deducting future accruals. Also, no external carryover import — any manual reimbursements would be separate and require compensation approval.

Noah (Recruiter): Quick FYI — we usually communicate blackout constraints to new hires during offer/intro, but happy to flag this as a docs gap.

Priya (New Hire): Thanks — Evan will confirm coverage and I'll submit the request now as "Blackout Exception". If we go unpaid, fine. Appreciate the quick replies! :smile:

PeopleOps Bot: TimeOff reminder: submitted requests in blackout will be queued for People Ops review; please allow 48 hours for response.

Samira (People Ops): Once submitted, tag me here with the TimeOff ID and Evan's approval note and I'll fast-track. Welcome again!
